trial_authorization.source: Direct user answer in this conversation
trial_authorization.scope: Existing one-minimal-dispatch-per-executor authorization; no increase or reset

continuous_operation.note: The existing minimal-trial confirmation does not reset consumed calls or authorize continuous dispatches.

metrics.scope: Required negative cases across peer, worker, reviewer, UI and artifact entry points
Application durable commit and receive acknowledgement; excludes writes never durably committed
Does not claim exactly-once arbitrary external API side effects

metrics.conditions: Continue already permitted work; model-provider connectivity recorded independently
Pin actual hardware and dataset; test paging, search, backlog and disk growth; physical and isolated observations remain distinct
Database query timing excludes network loading and model calls
Remote delivery latency is separate; no immediate offline stop promise

metrics.alternative: Explicitly report inability to terminate and escalate; never report stopped without proof

metrics.note: Acceptance target, not new calling authorization. Existing failures consume the original allowance.

metrics.conditions: Include offline/reconnect and reboot; no S0/S1; new issues reset the affected acceptance window
Complete authority-node loss; does not promise zero-loss disaster recovery

proposed_stop_conditions: No new dispatch when its authorization or remaining allowance is absent.
Stop new dispatches on unknown required budget accounting, revoked policy, invalid source/configuration or failed permission boundary.
Timeout/cancel requires an actual child-process exit/stop receipt or explicit attention state.
Connectivity loss alone does not revoke already acquired work; no automatic reassignment.
Pause new delivery on storage limit or inability to durably record evidence; preserve known state.
